rules: R8.1-R8.4 anticipation, contact, hold, follow-through, recovery to the RELAXED fight-ready pose; s11 Warden: committed, rotation-driven, the shield first; R1.2 the weapon carries 2-3x the body's motion. The read: a compact, terrifying top: the sword arm out at waist-to-chest height, the blade level and leading the turn, the shield tucked to her chest, the hips driving, one step per half turn.

prompts: A warrior woman spins round and round to her left in place like a whirlwind, stepping her right foot around her planted left foot every half turn, knees bent and leaning forward, her sword arm extended straight out at waist height and her shield pulled tight against her chest.
